summary: Iteration 4 — validated new enterprise features (OTP password reset, campus drives with moderation & pipeline, interviews with feedback, calendar/events, reminders, RBAC, dashboard widgets). Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (test_iteration4.py). Frontend UI smoke on all 3 roles: 13/16 checks pass; 2 'FAILs' are test-flakes not real bugs (documented below).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py forgot_password: rate limit counts ALL rows in the 15-min window (used or unused). Good — but the check uses count_documents on the raw window; if the user requests a legitimate reset >3 times legitimately (e.g. typo/OTP expired) they get 429 until the window slides. Consider counting distinct 'active' generation events or resetting the counter on successful password_reset.

verify_otp: attempts-left message says '4 - rec["attempts"]' but rec is the pre-increment doc; the value the client sees is the count remaining AFTER this failure. Correct behaviour but message can read as off-by-one on first wrong try (client sees '4 attempts left' on first wrong OTP). Cosmetic.

reset_password: the reset_token JWT has 10-min expiry and is single-use via otp_id -> used flag; good. But there's no cross-check that the JWT sub belongs to the same user as rec.user_id — since otp_id is unique this is fine, just document the invariant.

Drives list endpoint: student query filters moderation=='approved' and status not in ['cancelled'] — but drives with moderation='archived' from an earlier approved state may still be visible if status never changes. Consider hiding archived from students explicitly.

advance_stage sets status='placed' and freezes the student — but doesn't record placed_company/package if drive company doc has no company_name. Minor: for admin-created drives (no company row) placed_company will be None.
Calendar endpoint returns all events to every role without filter — fine for now but consider audience scoping (department-only events) later.
InterviewInput has no server-side date/time format validation — any string accepted. Add datetime.fromisoformat / regex for safety.
server.py is now 2117 lines — approaching unmaintainable. Split into modules (auth, drives, interviews, calendar, ai) in the next iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (3 checks flagged were test-timing/viewport issues, not bugs)

test_credentials: Used seeded creds only. Password reset UI test used a THROWAWAY registered student (TEST_ui_<ts>@x.com), so diya/aarav/kabir passwords remain at Student@123.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_ prefixed drives/events/students during the run; module-scoped fixture archives its own drive on teardown. TEST_ users remain in DB (registration is idempotent for these throwaway emails) — not disruptive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Post-login route is /app (not /dashboard). New pages: /app/drives, /app/interviews, /app/calendar, /forgot-password. Pytest runs with -n 2 loadscope by default; use -n 0 for serial. Frontend has ChatWidget floating on every /app page (chat-toggle-btn). Dashboard stat testids: student => stat-upcoming-interviews, stat-upcoming-drives, stat-pending-docs; recruiter => stat-todays-interviews, stat-recruiter-drives, stat-pending-feedback. Corresponding backend stat keys differ: pending_documents, upcoming_drives, todays_interviews, pending_feedback, upcoming_drives. Admin /api/admin/stats has active_drives, pending_interviews, todays_events.

explanation_of_3_ui_flakes.admin-create-event: Event created successfully (POST /api/events returned 200 and appeared in /api/calendar via backend test) but page.inner_text('body') did not contain the full event title because (a) the calendar defaults to CURRENT month while event was for 2026-02-25 which is not the current month in preview env, and (b) chips are rendered with truncate CSS but full title is in `title` attribute, not text node when clipped. Not a bug.
explanation_of_3_ui_flakes.widget-stat-upcoming-interviews & stat-u: Timing flake — query_selector fired before dashboard finished its SWR fetch/render on the aarav navigation. Earlier student screenshot (UITest new registration flow) clearly shows all 3 stat cards (UPCOMING INTERVIEWS, OPEN DRIVES, PENDING DOCUMENTS) rendered. Backend /api/student/stats returns all three keys (verified in test_student_stats). Not a bug.

rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. All new enterprise features (OTP reset, drives + moderation + pipeline, interviews + feedback, calendar + events, reminders, dashboard widgets, RBAC) work end-to-end on both API and UI layers.
